description: Measures its own width and cascades the resolved TmLayoutMode to its children. Auto registers a shared ResizeObserver and reports a change only when the mode changes; a forced Desktop, Tablet or Mobile never imports the observer, so a host or a test can render a layout without a DOM. The root carries tm-layout, tm-layout--{mode} and data-layout.

parameters.name: LayoutMode
parameters.description: Auto measures the root. Desktop, Tablet or Mobile force that layout and skip the observer.

parameters.name: LayoutModeChanged
parameters.description: Raised when the rendered mode changes. The initial value is not a change.

parameters.name: ChildContent
parameters.description: Content rendered inside the observed container. Reads the cascaded TmLayoutContext.

parameters.name: Class
parameters.description: Extra CSS classes appended to the root.

parameters.name: Style
parameters.description: Inline style appended to the root.
